tools.name: list_print_sizes
tools.description: The named print sizes `size` accepts, with their dimensions.

tools.name: plan_artwork
tools.description:
What to ask an image model for, before generating artwork for this print size.

Returns the pixel dimensions to generate at, the floor below which it will look soft,
the proportions, the smallest QR code that scans from where this piece is read, and a
line to paste into the image prompt.

tools.name: check_print_file
tools.description:
Check whether artwork will print correctly at the given size.

Give the artwork as file_url (public https link) or file_base64. `size` is required
for images. Returns the verdict, what is wrong, whether repair reaches a printable
file, and the prompt to regenerate with when it cannot.

tools.name: fix_print_file
tools.description:
Repair what can be repaired and return download links for the print-ready file.

Rebuilds QR codes so they scan, fixes proportions by adding paper rather than
cropping, and returns a PDF the size of the paper (inside a border a home printer can
reach, where the paper is one a home printer takes) plu
